false_success_traps: A message that a confirmation was sent and to check your email is not the end. The request counts only after the emailed link is used and the form behind it is sent.
Paid partner results on the site are not SmartBackgroundChecks listings. Do not count them when you check.

This project's automation follows an older flow: accept the terms, open the listing, and press the remove button on it. The live page on 2026-11-16 describes an emailed link and a form instead. Go by what the live page shows.
When you check later, compare the link of the listing. A different person with the same name was once mistaken for the original listing still being up.
genuine_confirmation: The site says you land on a confirmation page stating the request was received and is being processed, and that a confirmation email follows. A page that only says an email was sent, or to check your email for a link, means the request is not finished yet.
name: SmartBackgroundChecks

opt_out_url_check.note: HTTP 200 after a redirect to https://www.smartbackgroundchecks.com/remove. The page there describes an emailed-link flow that differs from the older flow in this project's automation.

steps: Open the SmartBackgroundChecks opt-out page. It forwards to the site's removal page.
Choose whether you are the subject of the request or an authorized agent.
On the opt-out form, fill in your name and an email address, and pass the robot check.
Open the email from the site and click its link. The site says the link stops working after 24 hours.
Fill in the opt-out form that the link opens. Fill in every field, and use details that match the listing you want removed.
Submit and wait for the confirmation page. The site says a confirmation email follows.
Allow about 3 days, then check that the listing is gone.
